profile.summary: A nonprofit arts and healing organization based in Oakland, California, doing business as The Center for ArtEsteem. It offers creative programs in schools and communities, public art murals, exhibitions, and professional development workshops. Its stated mission is to help people be self-aware and inspired through art, creativity, and education.
